effect.base: You create a pulse of necromantic energy causing a corpse to animate in a foul imitation of life. They will follow your commands for the next 1 minute, but will remain animated until destroyed. Your maximum mana pool is reduced by the combined creature levels of all undead under your control.

cs: Undead are powerful (+1 on all d20 checks).
Undead can understand and speak all languages known during their life
Undead gain +1 HP per creature level (minimum +1)
Undead deal +1 negative damage per creature level with all melee attacks (minimum +1)
cf: Undead animate, but you have no control and you are their sole target
Undead are weak (-1 on all d20 checks)
You gain weakness positive 3 for 1d3 minutes
You gain weakness negative 3 for 1d4+1 minutes
For the next hour, all undead within 200' of you can sense your exact location
You lose control of all your undead for 1d4 rounds
You again the undead trait for 1 hour
You are unable to Animate Dead for 1d4 minutes
All corpses in the AoE become immune to your attempts to Animate Dead for 24 hours
